formulas.name: Schwarzschild length scale
formulas.caution: Defines the radial normalization; it does not itself assert a Schwarzschild metric.

formulas.name: Normalized radius
formulas.caution: Dimensionless coordinate used by the branch functions.

formulas.name: Golden ratio
formulas.caution: A declared SSZ model parameter in the strong branch, not an empirical fit result by itself.

formulas.name: Strong branch
formulas.caution: Canonical P0 strong branch.

formulas.name: Weak branch
formulas.caution: Matches GM/(rc²) because r_s=2GM/c².

formulas.name: Blend coordinate
formulas.caution: Maps the transition interval to [0,1].

formulas.name: Quintic Hermite bridge
formulas.caution: Six coefficients match value, slope and curvature at both endpoints.

formulas.name: C² endpoint conditions
formulas.caution: The derivatives are with respect to the same normalized coordinate.

formulas.name: Time factor
formulas.caution: Maps the segment field to the static clock factor.

formulas.name: Radial stretch
formulas.caution: Reciprocal scaling used in the diagonal ansatz.

formulas.name: Static spherical metric
formulas.caution: The angular radius is areal: sphere area is 4πr².

formulas.name: Unit-sphere line element
formulas.caution: Angular part of the metric.

formulas.name: Static proper time
formulas.caution: Not the proper time of a photon.

formulas.name: Radial null coordinate slope
formulas.caution: Coordinate slope, not locally measured light speed.

formulas.name: Static emitter-observer redshift
formulas.caution: Requires both radii; z=Ξ only for an observer at infinity.

formulas.name: Static redshift to infinity
formulas.caution: Does not include Doppler, plasma or transfer effects.

formulas.name: Horizon segment value
formulas.caution: Finite canonical P0 value.

formulas.name: Horizon clock factor
formulas.caution: Finite horizon factor; not proof of a regular centre.

formulas.name: Central coefficient limit
formulas.caution: Finite A does not imply finite curvature.

formulas.name: Ricci leading asymptotic
formulas.caution: Diverges at the areal centre.

formulas.name: Kretschmann leading asymptotic
formulas.caution: Coordinate-invariant curvature divergence.

formulas.name: Leading PPN light deflection
formulas.caution: With γ=1 this gives 2r_s/b; not a strong-field ray trace.

formulas.name: Leading Shapiro delay
formulas.caution: Geometry and one-way/two-way conventions must be stated.

formulas.name: Perihelion advance
formulas.caution: Compatibility here does not validate the interior.

formulas.name: Leading Sagnac difference
formulas.caution: A is loop area here, not the metric coefficient A(r).

formulas.name: Null circular-orbit diagnostic
formulas.caution: A maximum is a candidate circular null orbit; stability needs full analysis.

formulas.name: Stationary geodesic constant
formulas.caution: A conserved geodesic quantity, not automatically locally measured energy.

formulas.name: Azimuthal geodesic constant
formulas.caution: Used with normalization and radial equations.
